Oscar A. Carlson High School had 72 Hispanic students enrolled in 2024-25
Oscar A. Carlson High School enrolled 72 Hispanic students in the 2024-25 school year, 2.7% fewer than the previous year, the Michigan Department of Education reported.
Records show Oscar A. Carlson High School enrolled 1,104 students during the 2024-25 school year. Hispanic students made up 6.5% of the student body, the third-most represented ethnicity. White students were the largest group, comprising 79.6% (879) of the student body.
The school is part of the Gibraltar School District, whose central office is in Rockwood.
Among the seven schools in the Gibraltar School District, Shumate Middle School had the highest enrollment of Hispanic students in the 2024-25 school year.
Michigan’s 2026 education budget totals $24.1 billion, including $19.5 billion from the School Aid Fund. Per-pupil funding was set at $10,050, a 4.6% increase from the previous year. The budget maintained free school meals and provided full funding for pre-K and community college.
